title: Clockwork Abyss
description: A surreal scene inside a geometric purple tunnel with glowing horizontal stripes. A large ornate clock with Roman numerals and a hypnotic eye at its center hangs at the top, dripping gold. Below, a hooded purple figure reads a book on the left while two men in black suits and top hats stand amid floating blue glowing orbs and swirling light patterns.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork of a vast geometric purple tunnel with glowing red and green horizontal bands converging toward a vanishing point. At the top center hangs an ornate red and gold clock with Roman numerals featuring a large hypnotic blue and red eye in the middle, with gold drips. In the lower left a hooded purple-robed figure holds an open book. Two men in elegant black suits and top hats stand in the center and foreground surrounded by floating bright blue glowing orbs, energy swirls, and light beams.
